data.why: The app ships its own models/sioc_app_target_models.joblib bundle containing trained pipelines plus a public-safe aggregate/analog reference table; the restricted literature CSV is intentionally absent and the app falls back to the bundled data automatically, so no uploads or seed files are needed.

goals: Enter a candidate Si/C/O/N wt.% composition and pyrolysis temperature/time to predict first-cycle reversible capacity (QRev), irreversible capacity, and Coulombic efficiency
Check whether a proposed composition falls inside or outside the training range and treat out-of-range predictions as extrapolative screening hypotheses
Compare predicted cycled capacity and apparent retention at 50/100/200 cycles across design-only versus diagnostic (QRev-assisted) model modes
Identify literature-guided precursor/synthesis route families that are chemically plausible for a target composition, filtered by a family composition-match score
Inspect composition-derived phase proxies (SiO2-like, SiC-like, free carbon, Si3N4-like) to interpret why a composition is predicted to perform a certain way
Review nearest public literature analog compositions and their DOI/source links for context on a candidate design

review.summary: The tree describes the app faithfully as a screen, trust-check and synthesis-recipe workflow for SiOC/SiOCN anodes, its labels are accurate, and 11 of the 12 screens I opened show what their nodes claim. It needs small fixes before filing: one misattributed screen, a wrong explanation of the route-filter quirk, two misplaced tasks, and features for the validation table and graphite comparison.
